Name: Speech Restoration System
Description: Repair a recording of speech where words are lost under noise: the lost words are said again in the voice of the speaker. The voice is a network trained on 1, 5, 15, 30 or 60 minutes of ONE speaker, the LJ Speech reader: compare them.
Asks: a damaged recording (ready-made, or a WAV file of the same speaker)
where it is damaged and the words said there
Keeps: Nothing: the restored speech is played; the stand-alone App writes it where the user says.
